title: Support carrying a grappled creature during non-walking movement (climb/fly), not just move(drag=...)

history.summary:
A grappler can now carry a grappled creature while flying, not just by walking with move(drag=...). The ticket names no acceptance tests, so there was nothing xfail to un-mark. Unit tests pass (158), the SRD and scenario suites pass (177), ruff is clean, and dev-gate passes.

Climb and swim already went through the same drag code, so they needed no change. Changes:
- **`move` in `dungdra/combat.py`** now has a `mode="fly"`. It uses the creature's Fly Speed and is refused (page 182) if the creature has none. A grappled creature's 0 Speed still blocks the move as before. The drag checks work the same in every mode: only the grappler can drag, every foot costs 1 extra foot unless the target is Tiny or 2+ sizes smaller, and the carried creature ends up next to the grappler.
- **`Session.cmd_move` in `dungdra/api.py`** now takes a `drag` argument, so players and scenarios can drag or carry through the command API instead of only by calling `move` directly.

Positions are still 2D, so carrying something while flying doesn't track height yet.
